dimensions.name: Planning work
dimensions.signal: Breaks a goal into steps with an order and a check for each step.
questions: Tell me about a piece of work you planned.

levels.0: Gave no example of the work.
levels.1: Gave an example and named their own part only when asked.
levels.2: Gave an example with their own actions and the result.
levels.3: As level 3, and named what they changed after the result.
